title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-samira-patel-alex-morris-2026-06-21
body:
Goal for this 1:1: align on Zenith Health renewal strategy, unblock technical escalation, and prioritize top 3 accounts for Q3 playbook outreach.

Attendees:
- Samira Patel (CSM)
- Alex Morris (AE)

Quick wins to surface:
- Demo follow-up sent last week: Alex to confirm they received the updated SSO instructions.
- Billing question resolved for Zenith (finance confirmed proration) — mention in renewal convo to remove friction.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Account health review (10 min)
  - Zenith Health: usage up 12% MoM but 3 stalled integrations (SSO, webhook delivery, custom dims).
  - Orion Labs: P1 latency report still open; engineering assigned but no ETA.
  - 3 small incubator accounts: on track for Q3 pilots.

2) Renewal plan for Zenith (10 min)
  - Current contract expires 2026-08-15. Targeting early renewal discussion week of 2026-07-20.
  - Renewal asks: committed throughput + Dedicated capacity pilot for 3 months.
  - Risks: stalled SSO + legal clause on data residency.
  - Prep: Alex to surface commercial flexibility; Samira to prepare tech remediation timeline and mitigation plan.

3) Escalation & engineering blockers (5 min)
  - P1 from Orion: need eng on-call sync. Action: Samira to open a PagerDuty rotation handoff (ticket -> JIRA-4521) and cc Alex.
  - Webhook failures (Zenith): ask for logs from their platform team. Action: Alex to nudge customer success engineer (Tyler) for logs by Fri 6/25.

4) Prioritization for Q3 outbound playbook (5 min)
  - Top 3 accounts to target for adoption playbook: Zenith Health, Nova Retail, Meridian Finance.
  - Action: build 1-pagers for each by 7/2. Alex to draft Nova Retail narrative; Samira to draft Zenith and Meridian technical lift notes.

Notes & context:
- Zenith SSO issue: customer reports 403 on metadata exchange. Likely mismatch in ACS URL. Related Confluence doc: customer-playbooks/zenith-health (link above).
- Renewal conversation: recommend proposing a 6-month dedicated pilot at 50% commit to lower their risk and prove perf. Need to confirm legal timeline for data residency clause.
- Pricing levers: usage credits vs committed discount; Alex to model two options and send to Samira by 6/28.

Action items (owner — due):
- Alex: confirm receipt of SSO instructions with Zenith and escalate to their infra lead (due 2026-06-22).
- Alex: draft Nova Retail outreach narrative and share draft (due 2026-07-02).
- Samira: prepare technical remediation timeline for Zenith (SSO + webhooks) and share with Alex (due 2026-06-25).
- Samira: open PagerDuty handoff and create JIRA-4521 with eng SRE owners (due 2026-06-21) — in progress.
- Tyler (CSE): collect webhook logs from Zenith and post in the thread (Alex to nudge) (due 2026-06-25).
- Alex + Samira: draft renewal proposal options (6-month pilot vs 12-month commit) and model ARR impact (due 2026-06-28).
- Samira: create 1-pagers for Zenith and Meridian (due 2026-07-02).

Parking lot / questions to resolve:
- Legal: timing for data residency amendment — who on legal to loop in? (Samira will ask Laila in legal)
- Engineering: can we provision a short-lived Dedicated pool in a new region for trial? Need SRE input.

Prep for next 1:1 (2026-06-28):
- Status update on SSO logs and JIRA-4521 owners.
- First draft of renewal proposal and pricing scenarios.
- Progress on 1-pagers for playbook outreach.

Tone notes to share with Alex in meeting:
- Be empathetic to their procurement timeline but firm on clear next steps.
- Use data (usage spikes, latency numbers) to justify pilot ask.
- Keep commercial ask simple: two options, one low-friction pilot.

Quick links referenced:
- Confluence: customer-playbooks/zenith-health
- JIRA: JIRA-4521 (orion-labs-p1)
- Slack thread: #zenith-implementation (internal)

Recent messages to reference:
- 6/18: Zenith infra lead confirmed they attempted SSO update but saw 403s; asked for ACS URL confirmation.
- 6/19: Finance approved proration for partial month billing.

Status flags (red/amber/green):
- Zenith Health: amber (integration blockers + renewal timeline)
- Orion Labs: red (P1 latency unresolved)
- Nova Retail / Meridian Finance: green (on track)

End of notes.
summary: 1:1 prep between Samira (CSM) and Alex (AE) focused on Zenith Health renewal, open engineering blockers, and Q3 playbook priorities. Action items assigned with dates.
